description: Accords collectifs nationaux is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Accords collectifs nationaux visant à mettre en place des politiques sociales communes à l’ensemble des salariés du Groupe public ferroviaire (SNCF). Ce jeu de données traduit la mise en place de l’unité sociale du Groupe public ferroviaire en 2015. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Social et ressources humaines. Its keywords are Social, Salariés, Organisations syndicales, Direction Cohésion. The portal shows 2017-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
